chunks: And by this chain, from Ja'far (peace be upon him), from his father (peace be upon him), that Allah revealed a book from His books to a prophet among the prophets,

in it is that there is [a creation] from My creatures who are pretenders, who lick/consume the world through religion, wearing the wool of sheep over hearts like the hearts of wolves, more bitter than gall, and their tongues are sweeter than honey, and their inner actions are more foul-smelling than a corpse.
Do you deceive Me with Myself? Or do you cheat Me? Or do you become arrogant against Me?
So by My honor, I swore that I will surely send upon them a trial/fitnah that will tread upon them in its bridle/reins until it reaches the ends of the earth.
It will leave the patient one from it bewildered regarding what the seer saw and the wisdom of the wise.
I will leave them as sects/factions and cause some of them to taste the punishment of others.
I will take revenge on My enemies through My enemies, and I will not care [about the method].

key_terms.أَنْتَنُ مِنَ الْجِيف: More foul-smelling than a corpse (inner corruption)
key_terms.لَمْحِسُون: Pretenders / Those who make themselves appear good
key_terms.يَلْحَسُونَ الدُّنْيَا: Licking/consuming the world (using it as a means)

ai.seo_question: What is the description of the 'pretenders' who use religion for worldly gain according to the revealed book?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* highlights the phenomenon of *riya'* (showing off), where the outward appearance of piety masks inner corruption, a key theme in Shia ethical theology. The divine oath emphasizes that Allah will use these hypocrites as instruments of their own destruction, sending a widespread trial that confounds even the wise, thereby fulfilling justice by turning their own factions against one another.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that Allah has  said in one  of  the  books  revealed on prophets,

“One of My creatures has made religion a way to acquire this world. They have the heart of a wolf and are wearing the  skin  of  a  sheep.  They  do  not  have  even  an  iota  of patience but their words are sweeter than honey. All of their hidden actions are having stench more than that of a corpse.
Will they cheat Me for mercy? Or they are stepping ahead of Me?
I swear by My honor that I will involve them in such a calamity that they will roll in it from one corner of earth to another.
It will be wise to split them in different groups
so that they take revenge from other such people over there.
My enemies will take revenge from My other enemies and I will not have to worry about it at all.”
